newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Xinde to issue 65 mln A shrs at 4 yuan/shr.
newsitem.headline: China's Xinde to issue 65 mln A shrs at 4 yuan/shr.

text.p: Xiamen Xinde Co Ltd will soon launch an offer of 65 million A shares in the city of Xiamen in Fujian province, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
The offer, priced at 4.00 yuan per share, has been approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, he told the Hong Kong-based China Securities Bulletin newsletter.
The Xiamen-based company, which makes computer components and develops computer software, plans to use funds raised from the issue to expand its main operations, the official said.
Fujian Xingye Securities Co Ltd has been appointed the lead underwriter for the offer, he said.
After the issue, Xinde will have a share capital of 200 million shares, consisting of 85 million state shares, 65 million A shares and 50 million staff shares.
The firm estimates its 1996 after-tax profits at more than 42 million yuan compared with about 30 million yuan in 1995, the official said.
